propositions: The docs/releasing.md runbook incorrectly describes the pypi GitHub environment's required-reviewers rule as 'the second human approval' when the sole reviewer is the configured release identity (JoeOakhartNava) with self-review permitted and admin bypass enabled.

The docs state operators must 'approve the pypi deployment when prompted' interactively, but the actual approval is non-interactive via the pending-deployments REST API cast by the same release identity that dispatches the run.

The environment rule guarantees identity control over which identity can release the publish job (holding until that identity approves the specific run), not independent second-party content review; the latter property derives from releasing only from Gerrit-reviewed main.

The non-interactive approval flow is undocumented: operators need a complete gh api POST /pending_deployments invocation with proper JSON body typing for environment_ids as an array, plus a companion GET read to discover the environment id.
The release.yml comment at line 294 repeats the same incorrect framing ('the second human gate on every publish') and must be corrected to match.
